In `mdb.c`, `DEFAULT_MAPSIZE` is defined conditionally:

```c
#ifdef _WIN32
#define DEFAULT_MAPSIZE  1048576      /* 1 MiB */
#else
#define DEFAULT_MAPSIZE  10485760     /* 10 MiB */
#endif
```

It is applied in `mdb_env_open()` when `env->me_mapsize` is still 0 (i.e., `mdb_env_set_mapsize()` was never called and no size was given at create time): the environment is mapped at that default size, and it is also the size recorded for a newly created database. This is why bindings such as Python's `lmdb` default to a 10 MiB `map_size`.

ANSWER: 10,485,760 bytes (10 MiB) on non-Windows platforms; 1,048,576 bytes (1 MiB) on Windows (`#ifdef _WIN32`)
